aplicacao_citacao: Sec.3.3.5 (p.9): 'The application of mortars in buildings include energy use for mixing and water use for hydration'; Sec.3.2.2: declared units per EN 998-2 (Specification for mortar for masonry - Masonry mortar).
nota: Argamassa de alvenaria (EN 998-2), nao betao. LCA cradle-to-gate (A1-A5), unidade declarada 1 L; o artigo nao menciona vida util em lado nenhum (texto integral lido, 18 p.).

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.1/2 e 3.1: 'energy-efficient solution for the external wall'; Sample 5 = 'commercially used 120-mm load-bearing concrete wall with 200 mm of rock wool insulation' (Table 2: 'Sandwich structure (traditional concrete framework)'), parede exterior de edificio.
nota: LCA cradle-to-gate por m2 de parede; nenhuma vida util declarada nem citada (so 'AAC ... could meet durability problems', sem numero). Alternativa possivel: pre_fabricado_corrente (o texto refere paineis de parede/blocos), mas o par 143 e a parede de betao armado de referencia de edificio.

aplicacao_citacao: Resumo/Cap.5 (Sec.5.1, p.96-115): matrizes AAM selecionadas 'for the development of ventilated facade panels, extruded and reinforced by PVA fiber'; 'This architectural solution is counted in the category of non-structural elements'. Cap.2/4: compositos extrudidos 'as an alternative to conventional fiber-cement used in the production of architectural elements such as panels, tiles, interior and exterior wall cladding'.
nota: read_file_content truncou a tese na p.78 (~153 mil caracteres); lida na integra por download + pdftotext (135 p., 314 mil caracteres). Nenhuma vida util (service life/lifespan/vida util) em todo o documento; LCA cradle-to-gate por 1 m3 de matriz (45 MPa) e por 1 m2 de painel. Os pares sao pastas do Cap.4 (Sec.4.1.3); a aplicacao final declarada da tese e painel de fachada ventilada nao estrutural (extrudido).

declarada.norma: NEC-15 (Norma Ecuatoriana de la Construccion, MIDUVI 2015)
declarada.citacao: Sec.2.1 (p.3): 'The buildings were designed to withstand gravity and seismic loads by the Ecuadorian construction standard (NEC-15) [28] ... The design earthquake is determined for a return period of 2500 years and a service life of 50 years'; Sec.2.2.4: 'phase-by-phase comparison over a 50-year life cycle'.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.2.1 (p.2-3): 'constructing an outpatient hospital as a case study ... four anti-seismic structural solutions are proposed for constructing this four-story building' (Quito, Ecuador); 4 sistemas estruturais (CB in situ, CM1/CM2 modulares pre-fabricados de betao, MSC aco).
nota: Valor gravado (50) confirmado. Os mesmos 50 anos aplicam-se aos 4 sistemas ('all alternatives would be designed by code requirements ... and the same lifespan').

declarada.citacao: Sec.2 (p.3): 'service lifes were estimated for all mixtures by FIB model [14]. The model assumes that chloride ingress complies with Fick's second law ... Rapid chloride migration test (RCMT) ... Extreme environmental condition of the Persian Gulf'; Eq.(3): 'Service life = e(3.6361) = 37.9 Years, (Conventional mix). Service life = e(3.9841) = 53.7 Years, (Circular mix)'.

declarada_por_par.citacao: Sec.2 Eq.(3), p.3: 'Service life = e(3.6361) = 37.9 Years, (Conventional mix)' (modelo fib de ingresso de cloretos, RCMT, etapa anterior do proprio projecto [14]).
Sec.2 Eq.(3), p.3: 'Service life = e(3.9841) = 53.7 Years, (Circular mix)'; 'service life is meaningfully increased (42%), from about 38 years ... to about 54 years'.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.2-4: comparacao de misturas de betao convencional e circular (1 m3, w/b 0,5, Teerao); durabilidade calculada para 'Extreme environmental condition of the Persian Gulf', sem elemento/estrutura declarado.
nota: Valores gravados (37,9 / 53,7) confirmados. Atencao: a equacao de vida util vem da etapa 2 do mesmo projecto (Habibi et al. [14]), calculada pelos autores com o modelo fib. No cenario de comparacao 'equal service life' o artigo usa 38 anos para as duas misturas (Circular (38-Y SL)); a unidade funcional proposta e impacto/(m3.ano).

declarada.citacao: Sec.2.4.1 (p.4): 'durability against carbonation-induced corrosion for the assumed 50 years of service life'.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.1 e 2.3 (p.1-3): 'One-way slabs are the most well-known flooring system for residential buildings'; 'a live load q = 3 kN/m2 was assumed for use in residential buildings'; 'An exposure class of XC3 was assumed as typical for the interior of buildings'.
nota: Valor gravado (50) confirmado. A frase dos 50 anos nao cita norma; o recobrimento foi dimensionado pelas classes XRC da revisao do Eurocodigo 2 (2021) e a Eq.(1) do XRC usa 50 anos de exposicao ([40]) - ligacao a norma plausivel mas nao escrita explicitamente, por isso classificado premissa_sem_fonte.

declarada.citacao: Sec.3.1 (p.5): 'The same target service life of 100 years was considered for all methods'; Fig.8: 'Normalized environmental impact over the life cycle of 100 years'.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.3.1 (p.4): 'The functional unit was an intervention on the Guillermaux Bridge (restoration or replacement) ... Payerne, Switzerland'; Method 1 = 'construction of a new post-tensioned reinforced concrete (P-RC) bridge'.
nota: Valor gravado (100) confirmado. Tambem citado na introducao (p.1): pontes suicas construidas em 1960-1980 'with a planned service life of 50 years' (Fig.1, ref.[5] OFROU) - nao adoptado. Manutencao: pavimento a cada 25 anos; no Method 1 membrana/betao deteriorado/lancis a cada 50 anos (intervalos de manutencao, nao vida util).

declarada.citacao: Sec.5.1 (p.6): 'it is assumed that panels have a service life of 100 years'; Table 2 (FU) 'How long? 100 years'; Sec.2 (p.2): 'it is estimated that CRC has a service life of 100 years, longer than the usual service life of SRC (usually estimated with an average of 60 years) [20,26]'.

aplicacao_citacao: Resumo e Table 2: 'A facade panel of carbon-reinforced concrete to protect the building structure from the effects of weather', 4000x3600x40 mm, C50/60, produzido em fabrica (modulo A3) e transportado para obra (A4).
nota: Valor gravado (100) confirmado. A premissa da Sec.5.1 nao traz citacao propria; a fonte dos 100 anos para CRC esta na Sec.2: [20] Spelter et al. 2019 (Appl. Sci. 9:1651) e [26] Backes et al. 2022 (Processes 10:1791). Se se preferir classificar pela frase da metodologia isolada seria premissa_sem_fonte. Mesmo paragrafo cita 60 anos medios para betao armado com aco (SRC) [20,26] - nao aplicavel ao material estudado.

declarada.citacao: Sec.2.2 (p.34): 'The end of life stage is not assessed as it is expected that the estimated service life of the beams will be more than 60 years'.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.2.1/2.2: vigas de laboratorio (BFRP pre-esforcadas e vigas com aco) ensaiadas a flexao; FU 'per reinforced concrete beam'. Conclusao (p.39): 'It is likely that the future market for basalt rebar will be within the precast industry rather than in on-site construction'.
nota: Valor gravado (60) confirmado, mas e limite inferior ('more than 60 years'), sem fonte. Aplicacao: vigas de laboratorio sem elemento/obra declarados; o artigo so aponta mercado futuro na pre-fabricacao (alternativa: pre_fabricado_corrente). A 'relaxation value of 6% after 50 years' (p.32) refere-se a relaxacao do varao BFRP, nao a vida util.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.1/3 (p.2-4): 'derive major environmental impact categories ... for each building material'; 'A database (DB) of the environmental impact specialization values of construction materials ... is required for the LCA of a building. Building owners and architects can easily determine the environmental impact of a building by multiplying the quantities of major construction materials'.
nota: Estudo de LCI/LCIA de materiais (betao pronto da base coreana, por m3); nenhuma vida util declarada nem citada (a ref.[22] sobre apartamentos de longa duracao nao da anos). Aplicacao 'edificio' porque o artigo enquadra os materiais como materiais de construcao de edificios; nao ha elemento especifico (alternativa: nao_definida).
